svg.title: Processes and ptys between a laptop and a tmux pane
svg.desc: On laptop A, Ghostty holds the master of the local pty and ssh holds the slave, in raw mode. Over an encrypted TCP channel on the host machine, sshd holds the master of the host pty and the tmux client holds the slave, also raw. The tmux client passes its fd to the tmux server, which holds the master of the pane pty whose line discipline is cooked, with bash on the slave. Echo travels back up the same chain.

g.text: Ghostty holds master · ssh holds slave
puts the local tty in raw mode
sshd holds master · tmux client slave
passes its fd, then just waits
server holds master · bash holds slave

svg.text: three ptys, three line disciplines, one of them actually cooking
